# wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap (Data Source)

Provides information about an LDAP (X.509 certificate based) authentication domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific LDAP authentication domain
data "wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap" "corporate" {
  domain_name = "corporate.local"
}

# Reference it when creating an authentication domain mapping
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "ldap_admins" {
  domain_id      = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap.corporate.id
  user_group     = "administrators"
  external_group = "CN=Bastion Administrators,OU=Groups,DC=corporate,DC=local"
}

# Check the X.509 certificate matching configuration
output "ldap_x509_settings" {
  value = {
    id                    = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap.corporate.id
    check_x509_san_email  = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap.corporate.check_x509_san_email
    x509_condition        = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap.corporate.x509_condition
    x509_search_filter    = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap.corporate.x509_search_filter
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `check_x509_san_email` (Boolean)
- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name_attribute` (String)
- `email_attribute` (String)
- `external_auths` (List of String)
- `group_attribute` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `language_attribute` (String)
- `pubkey_attribute` (String)
- `san_domain_name` (String)
- `secondary_auth` (List of String)
- `x509_condition` (String)
- `x509_search_filter` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Key

- `domain_name`: The LDAP authentication domain name to look up (Required). The data source
  fails if no authentication domain with this name exists.

### Returned Attributes

- **id**: Internal Bastion ID, usable as `domain_id` in `wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping`.
- **auth_domain_name**, **description**, **default_email_domain**, **default_language**,
  **is_default**: Domain identification and defaults.
- **display_name_attribute**, **email_attribute**, **group_attribute**, **language_attribute**,
  **pubkey_attribute**, **san_domain_name**: LDAP attribute mappings used to resolve user
  identity and public key/certificate information from the directory.
- **check_x509_san_email**, **x509_condition**, **x509_search_filter**: Configuration governing
  how X.509 client certificates are matched to LDAP entries during certificate-based
  authentication.
- **external_auths**, **secondary_auth**: Lists of related external/secondary authentication
  domain references.

### Usage in Resources

Use the returned `id` as the `domain_id` when creating a `wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping`
resource to map LDAP groups to Bastion user groups.
